Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.settings

Class SettingChangeEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.ZentrixEvent
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.settings.SettingChangeEvent
public final class SettingChangeEvent extends ZentrixEvent
Called after an editable settings.yml value was changed - in the settings menu or through SettingsService#set - saved and applied to the running server.

A notification. Values are as stored; Locations are the stored objects, so copy them before changing them.

Main thread; only fired while a listener is registered.

Since:
1.8.0
